tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. Warm paper by day, warm black by night. Everything sits on it; nothing else is this colour.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs: the one object lifted off the ground. Separated from it by `line`, never by a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet or a dimmed card when a bottom sheet is open; the queue list's hairline rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text on `ground` and `surface` (14.8:1 light, 15.4:1 dark). Also the fill of the primary button; `on-ink` goes on it.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill: the primary button, the verdict banner, the thumbnail-text block.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, meta, source quotes, counts. 6.3:1 on `ground`, 7.0:1 on `surface` (light); 7.5:1 and 6.6:1 (dark). Never for anything the reviewer must act on.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders, 1px. Decorative: carries no meaning, so it may sit under 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: A border that means something: the secondary button, the selected chip, the focused input. Same value as `ink` so it reads at 14:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the channel tag, the back arrow, the one coloured word on a screen. 6.9:1 on `ground` light, 8.4:1 dark. Not a button fill: actions are `ink`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill, which is rare (the channel-C stage-one badge).

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: A gate that passed, a canary caught, a stage-one approval. Always paired with the check mark; never the only cue.

tokens.name: on-pass
tokens.usage: The check mark on a `pass` disc: white by day, `ground` by night, so the mark holds 3:1 on both greens.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Attention that is not failure: a near miss, the paused-queue band, the missed-canary count. 5.0:1 on `surface` light, 4.6:1 on `ground`; 7.9:1 dark. Always paired with the `!` mark or a word.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a `signal` fill: the paused band.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: The scrim behind a bottom sheet: the card is still visible, out of reach.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every surface. Alias of `accent` in value; kept separate so it can change alone.

families.ui-ar: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and eyebrows, always in `muted` or `accent`. Letter-spaced because it is small and capitalised.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: 4 min 10 s on the card · expected about 6 min
styles.usage: Counts, timings, source lines, helper text. `muted`.

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Does the quote support the claim?
styles.usage: Default interface text: claims, form copy, chips.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: A row's name, a chip's text, a button's text at 16px.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button text. Buttons are 52px tall on a phone; never smaller than 44px.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Screen headings in the interface voice (instructions, states). A post's own title uses `title`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one large heading per top-level screen.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: We tested Notely for 7 days. Here is what the sync actually does.
styles.usage: The post's title on the card. Serif because it is the content under review, not the interface.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.sample: Why desalination costs what it costs
styles.usage: The title in a queue item or a sheet header.

styles.name: script
styles.sample: I kept a test log for seven days. Day one, I moved 140 notes in and nothing broke.
styles.usage: The script body and the opening-line input. Measure 60 to 70 characters: on a 390px phone that is the full width minus the 20px gutters.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: "ten runs, mean 12.1 s, max 19 s" · test log, 14 Oct
styles.usage: A verbatim source quote beside a claim, always in quotation marks, always with its source and date after a middle dot.

styles.name: ui-ar
styles.usage: Interface text in Arabic: one size up and more leading than `ui`, because Arabic sets smaller at the same nominal size.

styles.name: title-ar
styles.sample: لماذا تكلف تحلية المياه ما تكلفه
styles.usage: A channel-C post title. Naskh for reading, as the serif is for English.

styles.name: script-ar
styles.sample: احتفظت بسجل اختبار لمدة سبعة أيام.
styles.usage: The Arabic script body. Set `dir="rtl"` on the block, never on the page: the interface stays in the reviewer's language.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Post ids, hashes, rule ids (R-09), token fingerprints. `muted`. Never for anything a person must read as prose.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value; icon-to-text gap inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips in a wrap; between stacked rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on the short side; gap between a mark and its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The phone gutter, both sides, every screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen's first heading after the top bar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top safe area on a phone before the top bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The scrim-side corner of a bottom sheet's handle; small marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards. One value so objects of different kinds still read as one family.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The verdict banner and the paused band: the two surfaces that hold a whole state.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The top corners of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Reason chips, the reviewer name chip, the gate marks. A disc is a pill with equal sides.

border.note: Borders carry structure; shadows are not used anywhere.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every card and divider: 1px of `line`.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: A border that means something: secondary button, selected chip, focused input, in `line-strong`.

tokens.name: quote-bar
tokens.usage: The left (or, in RTL, right) bar on a source quote, in `line`.
